__snake__cx: On the way to T-F23, Arno "Rabbit" Snake tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
Blackwater Canal is lost. Arno "Rabbit" Snake heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Arno "Rabbit" Snake tried to remember the sound of the church bell in Varenne. Every version sounded like the ration bell. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Arno "Rabbit" Snake stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Arno "Rabbit" Snake was on wiring party in no man's land. Every time a flare went up he froze like a scarecrow. It worked.
Arno "Rabbit" Snake made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration.
Arno "Rabbit" Snake counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Henrik Zxburg was badly wounded.
Arno "Rabbit" Snake did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Arno "Rabbit" Snake fired back. Leopold "Rabbit" Dfeeney was grazed.
Fresh from training, Arno "Rabbit" Snake still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Benedikt Clintxix, badly wounded.
_psalm69: The quartermaster asked Yann Psalm to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
The trench wall shook against Yann Psalm's shoulder during the bombardment. He pressed both feet into the boards and waited for the next hit.
A flare caught Yann Psalm halfway through a yawn on the fire step. He stayed still until his jaw ached.
Yann Psalm offered a length of string for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity.
angelogia55: Jonas "Doc" Angelogia arrived at R-F22 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.

Jonas "Doc" Angelogia checked every ammunition belt by lamplight. One bad cartridge was enough to make him start the whole inspection again. A letter from home reached Jonas "Doc" Angelogia before dusk. Jonas "Doc" Angelogia read it twice and slept a little easier.

On sentry duty Jonas "Doc" Angelogia watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back. Day 6. The Hegemony took Hill 304. From the heights Jonas "Doc" Angelogia could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Jonas "Doc" Angelogia offered to read the newspaper aloud. The audience asked for the advertisements first, then the racing results, and the war last.
Jonas "Doc" Angelogia fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Yann "Brick" Zaza, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.
Jonas "Doc" Angelogia had marked the corner of the enemy trench with two stakes in daylight. At night the gun fired between the stakes, blind. Konrad Nsrr was grazed.
Jonas "Doc" Angelogia fired short bursts at the gap in the enemy wire, the way the sergeant taught. Albin "Saint" Zaza was badly wounded trying to cross it.

The water jacket hissed as Jonas "Doc" Angelogia fired across no man's land. When the gun went quiet, Valentin "Mud" Chavo was badly wounded. The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Jonas "Doc" Angelogia did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Jonas "Doc" Angelogia taught Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop. Jonas "Doc" Angelogia got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 287. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Jonas "Doc" Angelogia helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
A borrowed pencil wore down while Jonas "Doc" Angelogia was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first.

Machine-gun fire swept R-F22. Jonas "Doc" Angelogia took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Walter Metropolitan of the Concord (@metropolitan_wr). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Jonas "Doc" Angelogia fell at R-F22 and never moved again. Shot by Walter Metropolitan of the Concord (@metropolitan_wr).
The papers say Quentin Angelogia. The sergeant says he has his cousin's eyes. Jonas "Doc" Angelogia's eyes. Nobody in R-F22 argues.
The gun team argued about who carried the heaviest load. Quentin Angelogia offered to swap loads. The argument ended at once.
Quentin Angelogia did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Quentin Angelogia fired back. Valentin "Mud" Chavo was badly wounded.
Quentin Angelogia fired at the enemy dawn watch from R-F22. Henrik "Smokes" Kobold was gravely wounded, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
azok_78046: Benedikt Azok arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying a book with the last pages torn out and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Benedikt Azok wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Benedikt Azok wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats. Grey Mill is lost. Benedikt Azok heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Benedikt Azok gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.
Benedikt Azok rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Roland "Ghost" Idiot was grazed at the far edge of no man's land.
Benedikt Azok fired at the enemy dawn watch from S-R2. Anselm Perry was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.

Benedikt Azok was hit through the chest at S-R2. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Quentin Oorah of the Hegemony (@oorah961). Benedikt Azok was killed at S-R2 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Quentin Oorah of the Hegemony (@oorah961).
Nils "Spark" Azok had heard about Benedikt Azok's courage. At S-R2, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

A round went through Nils "Spark" Azok's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Bastian Abdukarimov of the Hegemony (@xojiakbar.abdukarimov1). Two shots, one miss. The second found Valentin Bladestalker, grazed. Nils "Spark" Azok cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not.
chrisoostuizen: Casimir "Whistle" Chrisoostuiz introduced himself as a clockmaker from Belmonte. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
Casimir "Whistle" Chrisoostuiz and Teodor Shadowizard have a secret signal: two taps on the helmet means 'still here'. They use it every night after the flares go out.

Casimir "Whistle" Chrisoostuiz made it into the enemy trench and out again, but a machine gun swept no man's land on the way home. Casimir "Whistle" Chrisoostuiz crawled the last yards. The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Casimir "Whistle" Chrisoostuiz did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again. A letter from home found Casimir "Whistle" Chrisoostuiz before the night shift. Casimir "Whistle" Chrisoostuiz folded it small and kept it close.

Casimir "Whistle" Chrisoostuiz came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon. A letter from home found Casimir "Whistle" Chrisoostuiz before the night shift. Casimir "Whistle" Chrisoostuiz folded it small and kept it close. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Casimir "Whistle" Chrisoostuiz is number 572. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Casimir "Whistle" Chrisoostuiz during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Casimir "Whistle" Chrisoostuiz had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Leopold Ker crossed it, Casimir "Whistle" Chrisoostuiz fired. Leopold Ker was grazed. Dawn watch. Casimir "Whistle" Chrisoostuiz put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Oskar Devonshireto, grazed.
A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Casimir "Whistle" Chrisoostuiz aimed a step ahead and fired: Isidor Waylon, grazed.

Casimir "Whistle" Chrisoostuiz noticed regular flashes from a gap beneath a roof beam. The position looks obvious enough to make him suspicious. A letter from home found Casimir "Whistle" Chrisoostuiz before the night shift. Casimir "Whistle" Chrisoostuiz folded it small and kept it close.
Across from S-S15, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Casimir "Whistle" Chrisoostuiz saw it. Silas Lakam was badly wounded.
Casimir "Whistle" Chrisoostuiz raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-S15. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Karel Leothebeo of the Concord (@leothebeo8).
coffee_slayer: By the time Karel Slayer reached U-F8, the war was 11 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Karel Slayer folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Dawn watch. Karel Slayer put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Marek Zilyox, grazed. A letter from home found Karel Slayer before the night shift. Karel Slayer folded it small and kept it close.

Karel Slayer and Gideon "Brick" Donathanpanc divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion. A letter from home found Karel Slayer before the night shift. Karel Slayer folded it small and kept it close.

A bullet hit Karel Slayer in the neck at U-F8. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Pavel Hite of the Concord (@kigh_as_a_hite). Karel Slayer was killed outright at U-F8, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Pavel Hite of the Concord (@kigh_as_a_hite).
The papers say Yann "Doc" Slayer. The sergeant says he has his father's eyes. Karel Slayer's eyes. Nobody in U-F8 argues.

Yann "Doc" Slayer fed a new belt into the gun and laid it on the enemy path at U-F8. Before dawn Rafael "Spark" Barba walked into it, badly wounded. Yann "Doc" Slayer was hit in the hip at U-F8. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Henrik "Ghost" Hero of the Concord (@hazy_hero). A letter from home found Yann "Doc" Slayer before the night shift. Yann "Doc" Slayer folded it small and kept it close.
A medic brought Yann "Doc" Slayer half a cup of soup and a promise. The soup was real. The corporal called out the mail. Yann "Doc" Slayer heard the name and almost ran.
donkay18035: Yann Donkay signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at P-F7 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at P-F7 changed before the cheering ended. Yann Donkay shouldered another load.
An empty jam tin became Yann Donkay's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips.
Yann Donkay is always the first one awake. Today, under fire at the Chalk Pits, that habit was the only steady thing in P-F7.
Yann Donkay of the Hegemony shouted a joke across the wire at Calvary Farm. Emil Only of the Concord laughed before remembering not to. Both lines heard it.

A bullet hit Yann Donkay in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at P-F7. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Roland Kahuna of the Concord (@kahuna382000).
Yann Donkay lay on the stretcher and listened to the surgeon working inside. He tried not to guess what each sound meant.
eliyork13: Bram Eliyork reported to U-F7 with a rosary of rough beads sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice. Grey Mill has been won. Bram Eliyork listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Frost made each footprint distinct. Bram Eliyork followed a trail to the missing ration sack and found the quartermaster sitting on it.

Bram Eliyork has learned to recognize the ration cart by its squeaky wheel. This afternoon, a different squeak caused real disappointment. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bram Eliyork. Bram Eliyork read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Across from U-F7, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Bram Eliyork saw it. Florian "Bones" Peterpopping was grazed.

Bram Eliyork fed a new belt into the gun and laid it on the enemy path at U-F7. Before dawn Gideon Garbet walked into it, grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bram Eliyork. Bram Eliyork read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Bram Eliyork went over with the night raiders, found the enemy trench empty at that spot, and came back with a bag of their biscuits.
euberitaminis: Day 6: Felix "Tin" Euberitamini reached R-S7 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

A crow sat on the parapet above Felix "Tin" Euberitamini all afternoon. The men say it chose him. A letter from home found Felix "Tin" Euberitamini before the night shift. Felix "Tin" Euberitamini folded it small and kept it close.
Felix "Tin" Euberitamini found an old map of the Ossuary Wood from before the war. There was a school on it, and an orchard. He looked for them. He did not find them.
Felix "Tin" Euberitamini tried to remember the price of a loaf in Dunmarrow. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought.
Pavel "Tin" Satan of the Concord shouted a joke across the wire at the Hanging Bridge. Felix "Tin" Euberitamini of the Hegemony laughed before remembering not to. Both lines heard it.
Felix "Tin" Euberitamini walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Felix "Tin" Euberitamini had just lit a cigarette at R-S7 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Nils Averelle of the Concord (@averelle_3d). A letter from home found Felix "Tin" Euberitamini before the night shift. Felix "Tin" Euberitamini folded it small and kept it close. Felix "Tin" Euberitamini got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 383. The men who came later will ask about it. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Felix "Tin" Euberitamini folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Felix "Tin" Euberitamini walked back up the communication trench to R-S7, slower than before, but on his own feet.
A round went through the rim of Felix "Tin" Euberitamini's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Marek Paulohwa of the Concord (@_paulohwa).

The medic looked at Felix "Tin" Euberitamini's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to R-S7. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows. A letter from home found Felix "Tin" Euberitamini before the night shift. Felix "Tin" Euberitamini folded it small and kept it close.
A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Felix "Tin" Euberitamini. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf.

Felix "Tin" Euberitamini fired at the sound of digging across the wire. The digging stopped. Ivo "Mud" Samwade was grazed. Felix "Tin" Euberitamini got a letter with a pressed leaf from the tree by the front door at home.
hazy_hero: Henrik "Ghost" Hero signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at U-F7 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.

Henrik "Ghost" Hero gave Casimir Addicted the last match in the trench. Casimir used it to light a candle so that Ghost could finish a letter. Grey Mill is lost. Henrik "Ghost" Hero heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
A round went through Henrik "Ghost" Hero's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Arno Ren of the Hegemony (@s1mply_ren).
Henrik "Ghost" Hero walked back up the communication trench to U-F7, slower than before, but on his own feet.
Dawn watch. Henrik "Ghost" Hero put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Gideon "Brick" Donathanpanc, badly wounded.
Henrik "Ghost" Hero rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Yann "Doc" Slayer was badly wounded at the far edge of no man's land.
Henrik "Ghost" Hero saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at U-F7 and fired once. Dorian "Spark" Donathanpanc was badly wounded.
hunnery707: Florian Hunnery took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Florian Hunnery shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Florian Hunnery agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Florian Hunnery watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
The artist tried again while Florian Hunnery read a letter. The new portrait was better, though the ears became the subject of discussion.
Florian Hunnery traded a cigarette for a pinch of salt. Supper improved. The argument about the exchange rate did not.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Machine-gun fire swept R-R13. Florian Hunnery took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet.
Florian Hunnery lay on the stretcher and listened to the surgeon working inside. He tried not to guess what each sound meant.
Florian Hunnery held on as long as he could on the stretcher outside the aid post. There were not enough hands, and not enough beds.
Walter Hunnery asked about Florian Hunnery on arriving at R-R13. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
jacob.creel.7: At the depot, Roland Creel had practised answering to his name. At N-F19, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
Roland Creel polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too.
jacobsoifu: Walter Jacobsoifu arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Walter Jacobsoifu watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Walter Jacobsoifu was carrying water up to S-R6 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Walter Jacobsoifu did not. Shot by Gustav Chongo of the Hegemony (@big__chongo). Walter Jacobsoifu stood up to fix a loose sandbag at S-R6. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Gustav Chongo of the Hegemony (@big__chongo).

Florian Jacobsoifu put a pressed cornflower beside the bunk. Someone who had known Walter Jacobsoifu helped clear the shelf without saying why. The clerk counted the names twice. Florian Jacobsoifu is number 905 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Florian Jacobsoifu read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Florian Jacobsoifu saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at S-R6 and fired once. Valentin "Saint" Oliverjarret was badly wounded.
Florian Jacobsoifu reached up to fix a sandbag at S-R6 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Albin Mouthfullofr of the Hegemony (@mouthfullofrocks).

A bullet found Florian Jacobsoifu at S-R6, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Henrik "Shadow" Soccer of the Hegemony (@cuyler_soccer26). The bearers reached Florian Jacobsoifu at S-R6 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Henrik "Shadow" Soccer of the Hegemony (@cuyler_soccer26).
The House of Jacobsoifu sent Jakub Jacobsoifu after Florian Jacobsoifu. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
Jakub Jacobsoifu measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.
A bullet grazed Jakub Jacobsoifu's ribs at S-R6. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Nils Gregoriousdo of the Hegemony (@gregoriousdonder).
josh_t_polley: Tobias Polley arrived on Day 9 as a replacement. The men in Q-F15 had been fighting for 9 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Tobias Polley wrote to a sweetheart who has stopped writing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Tobias Polley brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Tobias Polley watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Tobias Polley of the Concord spotted Bastian Barontheliet of the Hegemony repairing a parapet at Hill 304. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot.
Tobias Polley drew a map of Marek Brycetom's hometown from Marek's stories. Marek says it is wrong in every detail, and carries it everywhere.
Tobias Polley and Hugo "Crow" Data carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them.
Tobias Polley brought back a wounded man and a lost machine gun from Hill 304 in one trip. He is Lance Corporal now.
Tobias Polley stood at the parapet at dawn with the rest of Q-F15, bayonet fixed, staring into the grey. Nothing came. Nothing came yesterday, either.
no_one35643: In Kesselby, Karel "Doc" One was a tailor. In P-F16, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a tailor again. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Karel "Doc" One during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
An empty jam tin became Karel "Doc" One's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips.
Karel "Doc" One traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch.
Karel "Doc" One (Hegemony) and Emil "Brick" Xavidonegan (Concord) were sent out to cut the other side's wire at Lantern Hill on the same night. They met in the middle and agreed to go home.
Karel "Doc" One (Hegemony) and Florian "Lucky" Taishoredux (Concord) spotted the same abandoned cart near the Sunken Road. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was.
The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Karel "Doc" One asked to see the second one. The barber laughed.
senicfilms: Nobody saw Severin Senicfilms arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in N-F17, and a quiet machine gunner under it.

Severin Senicfilms took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at N-F17, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Lucien "Hollow" Moonroleen of the Concord (@moonroleen).
Severin Senicfilms spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice.
zksoon1: Nobody saw Casimir Zksoon arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in R-S8, and a quiet rifleman under it.
Casimir Zksoon and Walter Markdavis carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident.
A shell hit the latrine at R-S8. Nobody was hurt. Casimir Zksoon says it was the best day of the war.
A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Casimir Zksoon worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost.
New laces made Casimir Zksoon's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Casimir Zksoon looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Casimir Zksoon sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Casimir Zksoon is number 408. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. After the loss of Grey Mill, Casimir Zksoon helped stack spare sandbags at R-S8. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Casimir Zksoon passed ration containers down a chain of hands. By the time supper reached the front, every man smelled of it.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Casimir Zksoon said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know.
Casimir Zksoon's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.
Casimir Zksoon has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Gideon "Parson" Gibbons, grazed.
A second spoon disappeared. Casimir Zksoon searched the washing area and found a gap behind the board where everyone left cutlery to dry.
